\section{Results}

The baseline cell retains 92.4 percent of capacity after the protocol.
Fast charging costs the anode \textminus12.3 percent, while the cathode is
barely affected at \textminus1.4 percent.

Pulse charging deepens the same loss: the anode falls by
\textminus45.6 percent and the cathode by only \textminus3.1.
The separator moves less than \textminus0.5 either way.
Over 600 cycles with 24 cells per arm, the anode is the weak point under both.

\begin{tabular}{lrr}
Electrode & CC-CV & Pulse \\
Anode & \textbf{\textminus12.3} & \textbf{\textminus45.6} \\
Cathode & \textminus1.4 & \textminus3.1 \\
Separator & \textminus0.3 & \textminus0.5 \\
\end{tabular}
